extension.description: Reverses the letter order of Hebrew text in the editor (for example "םולש" becomes "שלום"), leaving other letters and numbers untouched.
command.reverse.title: Reverse Hebrew Text
config.mode.phrase: Reverse a whole Hebrew phrase at once, so the word order is flipped too. Numbers and Latin words inside the phrase keep their own letter order.
config.mode.word: Reverse each Hebrew word in place. Nothing else on the line moves.
config.showEditorTitleButton.description: Show the reverse button in the editor title bar.
